fullContentHtml:
AAI Junior Executive & Manager Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Airports Authority of India (AAI) has released the admit card for the post of Junior Executive, Manager. This recruitment was released for 389 posts. Applications for the AAI Junior Executive & Manager Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 August 2026, to 07 September 2026. The CBT examination is going to be conducted on 21-26 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their AAI Junior Executive & Manager Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 21-26 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 14 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

  • Download Admit Card

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Download Exam Pattern & Syllabus
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is AAI Junior Executive & Manager Admit Card 2026?

AAI Junior Executive & Manager Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
